newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian blue chips rally, Bombay index nears 4,000.
newsitem.headline: Indian blue chips rally, Bombay index nears 4,000.

text.p: ** (1215 GMT) - Indian stocks end with sharp gains fuelled
by heavy fund buying, traders say
** Funds keen buyers in index-heavyweight stocks; selling
** Bombay's top share index ends 55.24 pts, or 1.41 pct up
** Market faces hurdle to cross crucial 4,000 barrier, local investment buying restricted ahead of petroleum
price rise to be discussed by government on June 15
** Delhi share index up 2.16 pct at 838.14, Madras gains
